_comment: Who voices what (ElevenLabs). tools/generate_voices.py reads this; the game only reads the generated clips. Guards and Niro use eleven_v3 so the [audio tags] in 'delivery' carry the emotion; subtitles never show the tags. Swap any voice_id for one from the ElevenLabs Voice Library and re-run: only changed lines regenerate.

niro.name: Callum (husky, intense) - placeholder until a designed voice is kept
niro.design_brief: A man in his early thirties, a softly spoken, educated doctor whose calm keeps cracking: sudden giggles, whispered intensity, manic speed then dead stillness. Warm and frightening at once, like he loves you and has already decided what to do to you. Slight rasp. British.
niro.design_sample: Can you hear me? Good. I hate this thing too. [laughs softly] It makes me sound like them. [whispers] Come back to the chair, Miro. I'll make it quick. I always do.
